CloudStatus.//: Each provider is opt-in. Remove the block or leave required fields empty to disable. Secrets go through User Secrets or SCOUT__... environment variables — never commit them here.

Azure.//: Disabled by default — uncomment and set SubscriptionId to enable. Credentials come from DefaultAzureCredential unless ClientId + ClientSecretEnvVar + TenantId are set.

OracleCloud.//: OCI status endpoint is public — no credentials. Set Enabled to false to skip.

Aws.//: AWS Health API requires Business or Enterprise Support on the account. Uncomment this block to enable.

Kubernetes.//: Set UseInClusterConfig=true when running inside a pod. Otherwise set KubeconfigPath to a file (leave empty to disable).
